Seed — a single-line logotype.

A wordmark for Seed, an online holdings company, where S · E · E · D are drawn as one unbroken stroke — the letters joined, the final D closing the loop. It works reversed out in blue or black, or dark on white: simple, modern, and instantly a monogram.

Identity design — Anirudh Kapoor. A·48.
